about.disclaimer: Melodesk is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google LLC or YouTube. YouTube and YouTube Music are trademarks of Google LLC.
about.text: Melodesk is an open-source desktop client that drives the official YouTube Music web player. MIT licensed.

features.dependents: Turning this off also turns off {names}.
health.broken: Melodesk can’t control YouTube Music right now. An app update is probably needed.
health.degraded: Some controls may not work. An app update is probably needed.
health.slow: The player is taking a while to start. Reloading it usually helps.
karaoke.shortcuts: Space play/pause · ← → seek · [ ] adjust timing · Esc close
karaoke.untimed: These lyrics aren’t timed, so they can’t follow the music. Scroll to read along.
lyrics.caveat.abjad: Arabic and Hebrew are written without vowels, so romanization is approximate.
lyrics.caveat.kanji: Chinese characters and Japanese kanji are read as Mandarin offline, so romanization may be wrong.
lyrics.consent.body: The lyric text is sent to MyMemory (api.mymemory.translated.net) to be translated. Nothing else is sent, and each song is requested once, then kept on this computer. For full privacy, use a LibreTranslate server running on this computer instead (see translation settings).
lyrics.consent.title: Translate lyrics?
lyrics.err.libreAddress: Enter your LibreTranslate address, e.g. http://localhost:5000
lyrics.err.libreLocalOnly: Only a LibreTranslate server on this computer (localhost) is allowed.
lyrics.err.network: Could not reach the translation service ({detail})
lyrics.err.quota: Today’s free translation quota is used up. Try again tomorrow or use a local LibreTranslate.
lyrics.err.sameLanguage: The song language and the target language are the same.
lyrics.finder.artistHint: Leave empty if you are not sure
lyrics.finder.hint: Covers and remixes are uploaded under their own names. Type the song they are of and the lyrics are looked up for that.
lyrics.finder.title: Song title
lyrics.finder.wrong: Wrong or missing lyrics? Look up another song
lyrics.noTimed: No timed lyrics found for this song, so lines can’t follow the music.
lyrics.none: No lyrics available for this song.
lyrics.opt.label: Lyrics options
lyrics.playToSee: Play something to see its lyrics.
lyrics.serviceHint.libre: Nothing leaves this computer. Only localhost addresses are allowed.
lyrics.serviceHint.mymemory: Sends lyric text to api.mymemory.translated.net. Free daily limit applies.
lyrics.songLanguageHint: Romanized lyrics (like Hindi written in English letters) can’t be detected; pick the language here.
lyrics.timedBanner: These lyrics aren’t timed. LRCLIB can provide lyrics that follow the music; it receives the song title, artist and length.
lyrics.timingHint: If lines appear too soon, press Later; if they lag, press Earlier. Remembered for this song.
nav.signInForPlaylists: Sign in to see your playlists
visualizer.simulatedNote: Moves with the rhythm of playback. On this system Melodesk cannot hear the sound itself.
palette.title: Command palette
playlist.deleteBody: “{title}” will be deleted from your YouTube Music library.
playlist.form.title: Title
plugin.discord.description: Shows the current song as your Discord activity, with a link to it on YouTube Music.
plugin.discord.field.applicationId.hint: Create an application at discord.com/developers/applications and paste its Application ID. Its name is what Discord shows after "Listening to".
plugin.discord.field.applicationId.label: Discord application ID
plugin.discord.name: Discord Rich Presence
plugin.lastfm.description: Scrobbles what you listen to (title, artist, album) to your Last.fm account.
plugin.lastfm.field.apiKey.label: API key
plugin.lastfm.field.apiSecret.label: Shared secret
plugin.lastfm.name: Last.fm
plugin.listenbrainz.description: Submits what you listen to (title, artist, album) to your ListenBrainz account.
plugin.listenbrainz.field.token.label: User token
plugin.listenbrainz.name: ListenBrainz
plugin.lrclib.description: Shows lyrics from LRCLIB when YouTube Music has none. Sends the track title, artist and duration to lrclib.net.
plugin.lrclib.name: LRCLIB lyrics
plugins.intro: All plugins are off by default. Each one lists exactly what it can reach; integrations that send data say what they send.
plugins.group.activity.hint: Share what you listen to with other services.
plugins.group.identify.hint: Works out which song a cover or remix really is, so its lyrics can be found.
plugins.group.lyrics.hint: Where lyrics come from when YouTube Music has none, or only untimed ones. Every source you switch on is asked at once and the best answer wins.
plugins.title: Plugins
resume.title: Continue listening
queueTools.label: Queue tools
search.prompt: Type to search songs, albums, artists, playlists and podcasts.
settings.accent.hint: Colors across the app are generated from this accent in Material 3 Expressive's tonal palette, so text stays readable.
settings.artworkCacheHint_one: {count} cover kept, {size} of up to {max}. It still shows when you’re offline.
settings.artworkCacheHint_other: {count} covers kept, {size} of up to {max}. They still show when you’re offline.
settings.closeToTray: Keep playing when the window is closed
settings.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window hides it to the system tray.
settings.closeToTrayHintMac: Closing the window hides it; Melodesk stays in the menu bar and Dock.
settings.contrast.hint: Higher contrast makes text, outlines and controls easier to tell apart.
settings.featuresHint: Turn parts of Melodesk on or off. Changes apply immediately and are remembered.
settings.language.hint: Missing translations fall back to English. See docs/translating.md to add a language.
settings.notifyHint: Only while Melodesk is not the focused window.
settings.pageColors.hint: Artist, album and playlist pages take the colors of their artwork. The rest of the app keeps your accent.
settings.shortcutsHint: Work in every app while Melodesk is in the background, so avoid combinations you type or select text with. Click a field and press the keys; Esc cancels and Backspace clears. Media keys are handled by the system and need no setup.
settings.signInHint: Sign in happens on Google’s own page inside the player window.
settings.title: Settings
shortcut.err.clipboard: That is select all, copy, paste, cut or undo in other apps. Pick a different combination.
shortcut.err.editing: Arrow, Home/End and delete keys move or select text in other apps, so they can’t be global shortcuts. Try a letter or F-key with Cmd/Ctrl and Alt.
shortcut.err.noModifier: Add Cmd/Ctrl or Alt, or it would capture ordinary typing in every app.
stats.empty: Nothing recorded in this range yet. Play something and come back.
stats.subtitle: Computed on this computer from what Melodesk played. Never uploaded.
stats.summary.head: My Melodesk ({range}): {time} of music.
stats.title: Your listening

welcome.intro: Melodesk shows your own YouTube Music: your home feed, mixes, library and history, exactly as on the website. Sign in with Google in the player window; nothing about your account passes through Melodesk.
